name: The Keller Twelve
notes: A fitness block for a working student: 167 cm / 50 kg, training alone in a basement gym three times a week -- Tuesday and Thursday evening, Saturday morning -- for about half an hour, with an optional run or hike on Sunday. Every load in this file is snapped to the plate lattice described in inventory.json -- change the inventory and regenerate with tools/gen.py rather than editing loads by hand.

nutritionPhases.note: Four normal meals, a little more than you burn: fit, and slowly filling out.

rules: Eat your four meals. Skipping lunch on a long day is the easiest way to stall.
Leave 2 reps in the tank -- 3 during weeks 1 to 4.
Collars on. Check them mid-set. Spinlock collars work loose under load.
Never fail alone under a bar. Set the catch pins, or press dumbbells.
Add weight only when you earn it: top of the rep range on every set.
Log every set. A session you didn't log is a session you can't beat next week.
Half an hour means half an hour. If you are over, cut the last superset -- not the main lift, not the warm-up.
If something hurts -- not burns, HURTS -- stop the set, log the niggle, use the substitute.

cardioProgression.note: Sunday is optional: an easy run, or a hike instead. Start short.
A little longer, same easy pace.
Easy means you could talk the whole way.
Deload. Everything comes down, including this.
The longest Sunday of the cycle -- or the longest hike.
A 5K if you want to know your number. Optional.

items: Baseline photos -- all four poses, in the app's capture screen. It keeps them private; the phone's camera app would put them in the gallery
All five measurements: waist, chest, upper arm, thigh, neck
Confirm the kit: barbell 10 kg, EZ bar 7 kg, handles 2 kg (collars included); plates as listed in Settings → Your equipment
Measure ceiling clearance for overhead press and for skipping

strengthTargets.note: e1RM ~40 kg, 0.75x a 53 kg bodyweight. A FLOOR, not a goal.
e1RM ~23 kg, 0.44x a 53 kg bodyweight. The slowest-moving lift you own -- that is normal.
3 to 6 strict reps by week 12. The most satisfying number here.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.summary: Full body three times a week, about half an hour each: Tuesday and Thursday evening, Saturday morning. Light loads, perfect reps, every barbell lift introduced with the empty 10 kg bar.

days.title: Rest
days.note: Your long day: job, lectures, the German course. Nothing else. Eat your four meals.

days.title: Full Body A
days.note: Squat-led, about half an hour. Light on purpose — you are learning the patterns.

warnings.title: Set the catch pins
warnings.body: Before your first work set, set the stand's catch pins just below your bottom position. Miss a rep and you sit down; the bar lands on steel.

warnings.title: Collars on, checked mid-set
warnings.body: Spinlock collars work loose under load. A plate sliding off one end is the single most likely injury in your room.

drills.note: On the interlocking mats, never bare concrete.

prescriptions.coachNote: EMPTY BAR (10 kg) in week 1. Brace as if someone is about to punch your stomach, then sit down and stand up.
If you can't get 8, put your hands on the bench and do them at an incline.
Pull to the hip pocket, not the armpit. One full second at the top.
The second your lower back sags, the set is over.

days.title: Rest
days.note: Rest. A walk between lectures counts.

days.title: Full Body B
days.note: Hinge-led: the deadlift and the overhead press, then a quick pull-and-squat superset.

warnings.title: Bar height — read before your first pull
warnings.body: Your plates are small-diameter, so a lightly loaded bar sits too low and forces your back to round at the start. Stack the two 20 kg tri-grips flat and rest each end of the bar on them for every pull, warm-ups included, until the 20s themselves go on the bar: 50 kg and up (the 10 kg bar plus a 20 on each side).

warnings.title: Check the ceiling
warnings.body: Measure your overhead clearance before pressing. The basement beams and pipes are not at a uniform height.

warnings.title: Collars on, checked mid-set
warnings.body: Spinlock collars work loose under load. A plate sliding off one end is the single most likely injury in your room.

prescriptions.coachNote: EMPTY BAR (10 kg) from the blocks in week 1. Take the slack out of the bar before you pull — you should hear it click. Set it down and reset every rep.
Empty 10 kg bar in week 1. Ribs down, glutes and abs locked.
The more horizontal your body, the harder it gets. Log your foot position.
One bell, so it progresses by reps: 10 up to 15, three seconds down every rep.

days.title: Rest
days.note: Rest. Jumu'ah, the study project, home.

days.title: Full Body C
days.note: Press-led, plus the first work towards a pull-up. Saturday morning, then the weekend.

warnings.title: Bench pins at chest height
warnings.body: Set the pins so a failed rep lands on them and not on you. Never take the bench press to failure alone.

warnings.title: Collars on, checked mid-set
warnings.body: Spinlock collars work loose under load. A plate sliding off one end is the single most likely injury in your room.

prescriptions.coachNote: Empty 10 kg bar in week 1. Feet flat, shoulder blades pinched back and down, bar to the lower chest.
Same bar as the bench. Pull to the navel.
Step to the top, then fight the way down for five seconds. The road to your first pull-up.
Bodyweight only for four weeks. Harder than it looks.

days.title: Run or hike
days.note: Outside, easy, for the heart and the head. Optional.

prescriptions.coachNote: Conversational pace — or swap it for a hike and record that instead. Optional: a week without it is still a good week.

blocks.name: Build
blocks.summary: The same three days, a little heavier: fewer reps on the main lift, and the accessories supersetted so each session still fits in half an hour.

days.title: Rest
days.note: Rest. Your long day: work, lectures, the German course. Eat your four meals and sleep.

days.note: Squat-led. The most important set of your week is the first one.

prescriptions.coachNote: Drive the whole foot through the floor coming up — don't let the hips shoot up first.
Bench at its lower incline notch, roughly 30 degrees.
Same dumbbells as the press: no re-plate inside the superset.
No swinging. Curl the pelvis up towards the ribs.

days.title: Rest
days.note: Complete rest. A walk between lectures counts; nothing else is asked of you today.

days.title: Full Body B · Deadlift
days.note: Hinge and press. Short, heavy-ish, done.

prescriptions.coachNote: Same setup every rep: bar over mid-foot, shins to the bar, chest up, pull.
Ribs down. If you lean back to move it, it is too heavy.
A second vertical pull in the week buys the first strict pull-up.

days.title: Rest
days.note: Rest. Jumu'ah, the study project, home. Tomorrow morning is a session: get to bed.

days.title: Full Body C · Bench
days.note: Press and pull, then legs and trunk. The weekend starts after it.

warnings.title: Bench pins at chest height
warnings.body: Set the pins so a failed rep lands on them and not on you. Never take the bench press to failure alone.

warnings.title: Collars on, checked mid-set
warnings.body: Spinlock collars work loose under load. A plate sliding off one end is the single most likely injury in your room.

prescriptions.coachNote: Bar to the lower chest, elbows at 45-60 degrees. Pins at chest height.
Same bar as the bench. Your shoulders need the row on the day you press.

days.title: Run or hike
days.note: Outside, easy, for the heart and the head. Optional.

prescriptions.coachNote: Conversational pace — or swap it for a hike and record that instead. Optional: a week without it is still a good week.

blocks.name: Deload
blocks.summary: Same three days, 70% of the load, 60% of the sets, supersets unwound so nothing is rushed. You will want to skip this week -- it is the week the previous three turn into muscle.

blocks.name: Push
blocks.summary: Same three days, the lead lift of each one taken to 1 rep in reserve. Still half an hour.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.summary: Five-rep tests on the five barbell lifts across the three days, max strict pull-ups, and a 5K if you want it. These numbers seed cycle 2.

days.title: Rest
days.note: Test week. Rest today.
